steps.text: Work done = F s cosθ; the unit is the joule (J).
Kinetic energy = ½mv²; gravitational potential energy = mgh.
Mechanical energy is conserved when no dissipative force acts.
With friction, work done against friction is lost as thermal energy.
Power = work done / time = Fv; the unit is the watt (W).
Efficiency = useful output energy / total input energy.
